anchor_policy: One proposed invariance partner per existing Part-type A; no stimuli selected or rendered.
eligibility_rule: Both incorrect candidates already rendered; unique unchanged source gold; distinct labels; recorded anchors, text origins and conservative boxes in canvas.
projection_limit: Recorded projections and conservative text bounds only; occlusion, label legibility and visible geometric distinction require blind review.

different_source_type_proxy.interpretation: Different source types are a useful screening proxy, not visual qualification. Same-type instances may still be distinguishable by pose/color; different types may be visually ambiguous. No exclusion or selection is made here.
